ItemID: 1; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would consider a larger Alexa display for another room, since I already use an Echo Show 5.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought the second-generation Show 5, so this older version adds little for me.
ItemID: 3; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire TV Cube, Hands-free streaming device with Alexa, 4K Ultra HD, includes Alexa Voice Remote; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Hands-free TV control interests me, but I would keep using my recently purchased Fire TV setup this time.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A different color would not justify buying an older version of the display I already have.
ItemID: 6; Title: All-new Fire HD 10 tablet, 10.1", 1080p Full HD, 32 GB, latest model (2021 release), Black, without lockscreen ads; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try it for browsing and watching videos on a portable screen larger than my Echo Show.
ItemID: 7; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen) Adjustable Stand - Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently own a Show 8, so I would wait until choosing the display before buying its stand.
ItemID: 8; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa in the car sounds useful, but I would check how it connects to my car before choosing it.
ItemID: 9; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen) Adjustable Stand - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I just bought a stand for my second-generation Show 5 and have no immediate need for this one.
ItemID: 10; Title: Alexa Voice Remote (2nd Gen) with power and volume controls – requires compatible Fire TV device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current replacement need for the remote in my recent Fire TV setup.
